def find_substring(s1, s2, start):
    for i in range(start, len(s1) - len(s2) + 1):
        if s1[i] == s2[0]:
            match = True
            for j in range(1, len(s2)):
                if s1[i + j] != s2[j]:
                    match = False
                    break
            if match:
                return i
    return -1

def main():
    s1 = input().strip()
    pos = find_substring(s1, "at", 1)
    s2 = s1[:pos] + '@' + s1[pos + 2:]
    index = find_substring(s2, "dot", 1)
    last_pos = 0
    result = ""
    while index != -1 and index < len(s2) - 3:
        result += s2[last_pos:index] + "."
        last_pos = index + 3
        index = find_substring(s2, "dot", last_pos)
    result += s2[last_pos:]
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
